name: Shri Dhananjay Bhimrao Mahadik
education: B.Com. Educated at Rajarshi Chh. Shahu College, Kolhapur and Shivaji University, Kolhapur, Maharashtra
present_address: Flat No. 81 South Avenue, New Delhi - 110011
social_activities: Organizing dahi-handi programmes for the youth; cultural programmes for women; conducting scholarship exams and painting competitions for school students; organised wrestling, swimming, and kabaddi competitions; to work for the development of youth and women welfare; awarded, (i) Sansad Ratna (consecutively three times) by the Prime Point Foundation at IIT Madras and (ii) Second best Parliamentarian in the country Award
hobbies: Travelling abroad; reading books, petting, watching movies; owns a gym; President, (i) Kolhapur District Kabbadi Association and (ii) Petanque District Association; Member, Kolhapur Wrestling Association
countries_visited: Egypt, France, Singapore, South Africa, Switzerland, U.A.E., U.K., U.S.A., etc.
other_information: Chairman, Sugar factory; working for the upliftment of the marginalised sections of the society; established, (i) Bhima Business Group which is involved in welfare activities that have distinctively impacted the quality of life of the youth, women and the weaker sections of society, (ii) Dhananjay Mahadik Yuvashakti (an NGO), to provide a platform for young men and women to enhance the knowledge and skills and assist them in personal development, and (iii) Yuvashakti Food Bank, (with a motto ‘Not a single person in Kolhapur district should sleep hungry’), a noble social project catering to the families of the undernourished children and widows in distress in Kolhapur district; the project was launched by Rashtriya Yuva Sant P.P. Bhaiyyuji Maharaj; the food bank is distributing monthly requirement of food grains to large number of families; has been organising, (i) Bhima Festival, a two day annual cultural event in the month of January every year, (ii) Yuvashakti dahi-handi, an annual event organised on the day of Gopal kala which is attended by over 40,000 people, the biggest of its kind in western Maharashtra, (iii) Drawing Competition, every year, for school students which has a participation of about 20,000 students, (iv) Scholarship Competition for 1000 students selected from Kolhapur district and (v) Bhima Krushi, a state of the art Cattle/Agro/Urja/ Finance and Flora mega exhibition (Agri mega annual expo), with 800 exhibit stalls and 6 lakh visitors to the mega event
